item.description: EPRM-Book Ch10: Deploying a Model In short Using a model for predictions (inference) is technically simple: a side-effect-free function from a feature vector to a prediction, easy to wrap in a REST API, put in a container and scale.

item.title: Apache Airflow

item.title: Feature Store
item.description: Feature Store Definition Feature store A central system that catalogues reusable feature-engineering code and computes, precomputes and caches feature vectors, so several models and teams can use the same features without reimplementing them.

item.title: Training-Serving Skew
item.description: Training-Serving Skew Definition Training-serving skew A mismatch between how inputs are turned into features during training and during inference (serving).

item.title: A3C
item.description: A3C Definition A3C (Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic) A3C is an on-policy, deep Actor-Critic algorithm (Mnih et al., 2016) that runs many actor-learners in parallel, each on its own copy of the environment, asynchronously updating a shared set of global parameters.

item.title: Action-Value Methods
item.description: Action-Value Methods Definition Action-Value Methods Action-value methods estimate the value of each action — the expected reward (or return) of selecting it — and then use those estimates to drive action selection.
